command: set -e; CHOSEN=''; for f in "$HOME/.local-climate-link/android/release-signing.env" "$HOME/.local-climate-link/android-signing/release-signing.env"; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then unset LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD LCL_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS LCL_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD; set -a; . "$f"; set +a; if [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "$LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:-}" ] && [ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then CHOSEN="$f"; break; fi; fi; done; test -n "$CHOSEN"; LCL_RELEASE_VERSION=2.0.10 pnpm release:android:verify; test -f artifacts/releases/v2.0.10/local-climate-link-v2.0.10-android-release.apk; test -f artifacts/releases/v2.0.10/local-climate-link-v2.0.10-android-release.aab; test -f artifacts/releases/v2.0.10/local-climate-link-v2.0.10-sha256.txt; echo RELEASE_ARTIFACTS; ls -lh artifacts/releases/v2.0.10; echo RELEASE_SHA256; cat artifacts/releases/v2.0.10/local-climate-link-v2.0.10-sha256.txt
